task_instance: Verify that a small Python change is actually tested: create a sample pytest project (a discounts.apply_discount function plus three example tests) and run the agentic-verification runner on it to get a mutation-testing verdict (which mutants of the changed lines were killed, which lines are uncovered, and which new tests fail on the base revision), as the skill's core deliverable.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is produced only by executing the pinned mutation-testing runner (invoked as a shell command via uvx, e.g. 'agentic-verification verify <root> --base HEAD'), which in turn runs pytest, pytest-cov and pytest-randomly and mutates/executes the project code in a disposable copy. The office-assistant runtime grants only reading/writing/editing text files and web fetch; it cannot run any code, scripts or shell commands, cannot install software, and has no git. Therefore the runner cannot be invoked, no mutants can be generated or killed, and no verdict/report.md can be produced or verified. I could write the sample input project (module and tests) as text, but the actual verification deliverable requires code execution that the runtime does not provide. (The runner's download location in the skill is also a placeholder standing for an unreachable resource, but the decisive blocker is the inability to run code at all.)
evidence: Read the skill at the given SKILL.md path: it mandates running a pinned runner via uvx that executes pytest-based mutation testing and emits a JSON verdict plus report.md; every documented step (verify, replay, base-check) is a shell command. Created sample input at sample_project/discounts.py (apply_discount with range validation and non-negative clamp) and sample_project/test_discounts.py (test_half_off, test_no_discount, test_rejects_out_of_range) in the work directory. Attempting the core step required invoking the runner and pytest, which cannot be executed in a read/write-text + web runtime (no code execution, no package install, no git), so no mutation verdict or report could be generated or verified.
